summary: std/tls: a TLS peer certificate with an RSA key over 8192 bits is refused, with Go's text (`tls: server sent certificate containing RSA key larger than 8192 bits`), before any signature is verified...
details: a TLS peer certificate with an RSA key over 8192 bits is refused, with Go's text (`tls: server sent certificate containing RSA key larger than 8192 bits`), before any signature is verified (CVE-2023-29409, GO-2023-1987: huge keys made the peer spend CPU time). The Go backend already refused them.
